name: lanyard-react-bits

frames.best_why: The badge hangs upright and centred with the strap, clip, photo and glossy edge all visible.

tagline: A photo ID badge on a strap swings, drags and flips in 3D.
summary: A realistic ID badge hanging from a woven strap on a black stage. It sways under gravity, can be grabbed and thrown with the pointer, and flips over when clicked.
appearance: A glossy portrait-format badge with rounded corners and a punched slot, hung by a silver clip from a dark woven ribbon that rises out of the frame. The badge holds a full-bleed photo, with a faint grain and soft studio reflections across its surface.
behaviour: The strap and badge swing on a spring like a real lanyard, never quite still in the ambient breeze. Dragging the card moves it in 3D, releasing throws it, and a short click flips it to a back face.
demo_content: A studio portrait of a smiling woman in a deep red top against a blurred indoor background.
search_phrases: card you can throw and flip
use_when: A profile, event pass or product needs a tactile 3D object that invites dragging and flipping.
avoid_when: It is a heavy WebGL scene that needs a tall parent, and weak devices make the physics stutter.
customise: Front and back image, fit, card colour, orientation, finish, corners, size, anchor, strap length/image/colour/width, metal, gravity, damping, elasticity, breeze and interactivity are props.
weight_why: A three.js scene with a physics loop and shaders renders every frame, kept moving by a breeze.

a11y.note: The canvas has no label or keyboard controls; reduced motion only stops the ambient breeze, dragging and flipping stay pointer-only.

polish_why: Convincing 3D strap physics and a clean glossy card; the stage is very dark and sparse.
